title: rev-stealth doctor --output-format json
description: JSON payload emitted by `rev-stealth doctor --output-format json`. v1.3 Lane G.4 contract. Doctor uses NO shared envelope — it serializes `DoctorReport` (or `DeepReport` when --deep) directly. Reference emitter: `crates/stealth-cli/src/doctor.rs::emit_report` / `emit_deep_report`. Fail-closed: exit code 7 on any leak.

anyOf.title: doctor --vps (top-level array of DeepCheck rows)
anyOf.description: P10.3: emitted as a single top-level array (NOT wrapped) so callers can pipe through jq / json.tool. When --deep and --vps are combined, deep rows are concatenated ahead of vps rows.

$comment: anyOf (not oneOf) because DeepReport's fields are all optional, so a DoctorReport object will also structurally validate against deep_report. The CLI flag set (--deep / --vps) disambiguates at the call site; callers should select the variant matching the flags they passed.

exit_ip_ok.description: True when probe succeeded OR was skipped via --skip-exit-ip; false on any probe failure / country mismatch / ASN-deny.

errors.description: Per-check failure detail (skip_serializing_if=Vec::is_empty in Rust serde — omitted when empty).
